title: Humberstone Ranch Visit with Mini Domestic Animals
includes: All vegetables and feed for animals
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Humberstone Ranch offers an unforgettable farm visit where meaningful connections with animals take center stage. It’s not just about visiting; it’s about bonding. 

Imagine brushing Winnie, Lenny, and Lola, our affectionate miniature horses, or giving Charlotte and Wilbur, our kunekune piglets, a belly rub they eagerly await. 

Marvel at the majestic Texas Longhorns as you feed them and learn about their storied past. Our quirky Indian Runner Ducks, with their upright stance, will charm you as they waddle about. 

The lively goats, especially the cuddly mini fainting twins, Valentine and Clementine, are always ready for fun. 

In our serene garden, hand-feed our gentle rabbits, enjoying their calm, peaceful nature. 

At Humberstone Ranch, each moment is designed to create lasting memories and deep connections, making your visit truly unique.
